<h2 style="margin-top:28px">Key findings</h2>
<ol class="kf">
 <li><b>The delay is a rate, not a gap.</b>Against U38, 276 wd elapsed delivered only 82 wd of planned progress: SPI(t) 0.30. Against U29, 197 of 466: 0.42. SV(t) is −269, −247 and −194 wd against U29, U32 and U38, and grows every update with no turning point. No baseline was planned at demonstrated pace: U29 and U32 needed about 455 finishes per month over their first year, above the best month ever (406); U38 needed 349, 1.6 times the last twelve months (216), with a 621 peak in its second month.</li>
 <li><b>Re-baselining reset the counter, not the trend.</b>U32 and U38 each start at zero and fall back onto the same slope, about −15 wd per update. U32 is almost indistinguishable from U29.</li>
 <li><b>The finish milestone hid the delay for nine updates.</b>At U47 progress was 141 wd behind U38 while EXS.130 had moved 20 wd. EXS.130 never had positive float and durations were not shortened: the date held mainly because the schedule assumed about 300 activity completions per month while the field delivered 150–231. The commissioning logic rework helped only a little: rerun with the previous update's logic, EXS.130 lands 5 wd later in U44 and 15 wd later in U47. The gap surfaced at once in U48 and U50.</li>
 <li><b>Pace never recovered after the 2025–26 winter.</b>January and February are slow in both winters (133 and 224 finishes in 2025, 111 and 98 in 2026), but spring 2025 climbed back to about 300 per month while spring 2026 stalled at about 230. The drop from Sep–Dec 2025 (352/month) to Jan–Apr 2026 (168/month) was spread across trades: mechanical (Harris HVAC, plumbing, fitters, insulation and the mechanical fragnet) 47%, painting 12%, Helix 9%. U41 had planned 2,394 finishes for those four months; 660 happened. The schedules show where it fell, not why.</li>
 <li><b>U51 is feasible on average, not in the near term.</b>Reaching EXS.130 needs 176 completions per month against 213 delivered, the first coherent forecast since U41. Its early dates still load 479 per month over the next six months, so interim dates will keep slipping. 27-Mar-2028 holds only if pace stays at or above about 176 per month. By capacity alone, the 2,964 open activities upstream of EXS.130 finish between 22-Dec-2027 and 18-Jan-2028 at the pace of the last twelve and six months: the PCO 1643 logic, not capacity, sets the date today.</li>
 <li><b>Helix is as late as the project and slowing.</b>SV(t) −250 wd against U29 and −181 against U38. Pace dropped from 44 to 35.5 completions per month; U51 needs about 55.</li>
 <li><b>Mechanical commissioning and change work, not Helix, drive Substantial Completion.</b>From U38 to U51 the path that sets EXS.130 runs through Final Integrated System Testing. Change work fed it in U38–U40 (RFP 086 / PCO 0831, NCI lab bulletin) and has owned it since U50 (RF shielding PCO 1643, which P6's own Longest Path confirms and which carries on to project completion in 2030). In U41–U49 it ran through mechanical commissioning: air-system testing, AHU start-up and chilled-water hydronics. Helix sat on it only in U43 (B2 switchgear energization, behind Fragnet 001). Helix's last activity feeding EXS.130 moved 24 wd from U48 to U51 while EXS.130 moved eight months; the gap grew from 53 to 203 wd. PCO 1643 includes MEPF and device scope but no Helix-coded activity.</li>
 <li><b>Schedule control is masking the reading.</b>The only contract-type date in the XER, the "finish on or before" on Phase 5 Complete, moved from 16-Sep-2028 to 13-Oct-2028 in U35 (the U29 forecast) and to 25-Jan-2029 in U38 (that month's forecast), which reset EXS.130 float to zero. P2.PIA.120 logic was re-tied at U47 (8,937 to 6,547 predecessors). Since U29, 1,187 activities were added and 121 deleted. Out-of-sequence progress rose from 2 relationships in U29 to 264 in U41 and stands at 137 in U51.</li>
 <li><b>PCO 1643 explains 49 to 137 working days of the Substantial Completion slip.</b>Removing it from U51 moves EXS.130 to 10-Sep-2027 (137 wd earlier) and project completion to 16-Jun-2029. The 10-Sep-2027 date needs 284 finishes per month; at demonstrated pace the remaining work ends 22-Dec-2027 to 18-Jan-2028, so the net effect is 49–66 wd. At least 99 of the 236 wd EXS.130 has slipped against U38 have other causes. Without the PCO, the project still finishes 101 wd after the current must-finish date (25-Jan-2029).</li>
</ol>

<section class="band" style="padding-top:0"><div class="wrap">
<h2>Who drives Substantial Completion, and why Helix barely moves</h2>
<p class="lede">Helix has been on the path that sets EXS.130 in one update of fourteen: U43, when B2 switchgear energization sat behind Fragnet 001. Mechanical commissioning set the date in U41–U49; change work set it in U38–U40 and again since U50, when the RF shielding PCO took over. P6's own Longest Path in U50 and U51 is the same chain and carries on through NIH moves and Phase 3, 4 and 5 to project completion on 01-Jan-2030. Helix's last activity feeding EXS.130, CX.FA.1040 Life Safety Acceptance Testing, moved 24 working days from U48 to U51 while EXS.130 moved eight months: the distance between them grew from 53 to 203 working days.</p>
<div class="sheet" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="fig" style="height:clamp(300px,42vh,440px)"><svg id="s6" role="img" aria-label="EXS.130 forecast versus Helix last finish by update, coloured by driving path"></svg></div>
<div class="legend"><span><i style="border-color:var(--m0)"></i>EXS.130 forecast</span><span><i style="border-color:var(--act)"></i>Helix last activity feeding EXS.130</span><span><span class="dot" style="background:var(--cm)"></span>Driven by mechanical commissioning</span><span><span class="dot" style="background:var(--ch)"></span>Helix on the driving path</span><span><span class="dot" style="background:var(--cc)"></span>Driven by PCO / Fragnet</span></div></div>
<div class="scroll" style="margin-top:14px"><table class="stack" id="dtbl"></table></div>
<h2 style="margin-top:30px">Helix exposure to change work at U51</h2>
<div class="cards">
 <div><b>4</b><span>Helix activities inside PCO 0187 (B2 / BR 1800 &amp; 1802): fire alarm and electrical rough-in, trim and lights, finishing Mar–Apr 2027.</span></div>
 <div><b>42</b><span>Open Helix activities downstream of PCO or Fragnet activities: B2 trims, generator and ATS functional tests, and CX.FA.1040 itself.</span></div>
 <div><b>0 of 30</b><span>Activities in PCO 1643, the change now driving EXS.130, coded to Helix, although it includes LOTO make-safe MEPF, overhead and in-wall MEPF, MEPF into the RF room and device drops.</span></div>
</div>
<div class="flag"><b>Logic to confirm.</b> CX.FA.1040 Life Safety Acceptance Testing finishes 08-Jun-2027, but the RF room B2-2840, with its device drops and ceilings, is built from Nov-2027 to Mar-2028. If that room carries fire alarm devices, acceptance testing would have to be repeated, and PCO 1643 should tie into CX.FA.1040. Helix's flat finish date may partly reflect how the change is coded, not a lack of impact.</div>
</div></section>

<section class="band" style="padding-top:0"><div class="wrap">
<h2>What PCO 1643 costs in time, and the only contract date the schedule carries</h2>
<p class="lede">Removing the 26 open activities of PCO 1643 from U51 and recalculating (same progress, durations and remaining logic) moves EXS.130 from 27-Mar-2028 to 10-Sep-2027: 137 working days. Removing every open PCO and Fragnet activity (264) gains only 3 more. But 10-Sep-2027 needs 284 finishes per month, the 2025 average, against 204–216 over the last year. At demonstrated pace the same work ends 22-Dec-2027 to 18-Jan-2028, so the net effect of PCO 1643 on Substantial Completion is between 49 and 137 working days. Of the 236 working days EXS.130 has slipped against U38, at least 99 are not explained by PCO 1643.</p>

<tr><td data-l="Scenario (U51)">Without any open PCO / Fragnet work (264)</td><td data-l="EXS.130">07-Sep-2027</td><td data-l="vs U51">−140</td><td data-l="EXS.140">13-Jun-2029</td><td data-l="vs U51">−139</td></tr>
<tr><td data-l="Scenario (U51)">Without PCO 1643, limited by demonstrated pace (216 / 204 per month)</td><td data-l="EXS.130">22-Dec-2027 to 18-Jan-2028</td><td data-l="vs U51">−66 to −49</td><td data-l="EXS.140">not estimated</td><td data-l="vs U51">—</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
<p class="lede" style="font-size:15px;margin-top:10px">The same test on U50 (PCO XXX, the earlier version of the RF shielding change) gives 134 working days, so the result is stable between updates. This measures the time the PCO adds as modelled in the schedule. It does not establish responsibility or entitlement. The PCO 1643 chain starts with "NIH Unilateral Contract Modification Issued" (18-Sep-2026) and an RFI confirming a design change (DES-0515, 15-Oct-2026); its full scope was not available.</p>

<section class="band" style="padding-top:0"><div class="wrap">
<h2>Schedule integrity: what else moved the dates</h2>
<p class="lede">The commissioning logic was rewired twice inside the window where the milestone hid the delay: in U44, 400 live relationships removed and 546 added; in U47, 1,403 removed and 1,281 added, mostly commissioning chains, all upstream of EXS.130. Rerunning each update with the previous update's logic (same progress and durations, own forward pass that reproduces P6's EXS.130 date) puts EXS.130 5 working days later in U44 and 15 later in U47. The rework held the date by about three weeks, a small part of the 121 working days the milestone was hiding.</p>

<section class="band" style="padding-top:0"><div class="wrap">

const st={scen:"full",scope:"all",met:"cnt",scale:"log",fan:"1",win:"u",u:51,ms:{"EXS.130":true,"P2.PIA.120":false,"P2.PIA.130":false}};
const BL=D.bl,MSK=Object.keys(D.ms),MSC={"EXS.130":"--m0","P2.PIA.120":"--m1","P2.PIA.130":"--m2"};
const sv=v=>v==null?"—":(v>0?"+":"")+v+" wd";
const HOL=new Set(D.hol);
const bus=(a,b)=>{let n=0;const d=new Date(a+"T12:00"),e=new Date(b+"T12:00");while(d<e){const w=d.getDay(),k=d.getFullYear()+"-"+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")+"-"+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,"0");if(w>0&&w<6&&!HOL.has(k))n++;d.setDate(d.getDate()+1)}return n};
const dDiff=(a,b)=>a>=b?bus(b,a):-bus(a,b);
const M=D.months.map(s=>{const [y,m]=s.split("-").map(Number);return new Date(y,m,0,23,59)});
const ms=s=>new Date(s+"T08:00");
const MES=["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"];
const fd=s=>{const d=ms(s);return String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")+"-"+MES[d.getMonth()]+"-"+d.getFullYear()};
const nf=x=>Math.round(x).toLocaleString("en-US");
const unit=()=>st.met==="cnt"?"activities":"activity-days";
const cur=()=>D.sets[`${st.scen}|${st.scope}|${st.met}`];
const kOf=u=>cur().kpi.find(k=>k.u===u);
const segs=[["sScen","scen"],["sScope","scope"],["sMet","met"],["sScale","scale"],["sWin","win"],["sFan","fan"]];
function syncSeg(){segs.forEach(([id,k])=>document.querySelectorAll("#"+id+" button").forEach(b=>b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",b.dataset.v===st[k])))}
segs.forEach(([id,k])=>document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("button");if(!b)return;st[k]=b.dataset.v;all()}));
document.getElementById("msChk").innerHTML=MSK.map(m=>`<label><input type="checkbox" data-m="${m}" ${st.ms[m]?"checked":""}><i style="border-color:var(${MSC[m]})"></i>${m}</label>`).join("");
document.getElementById("msChk").addEventListener("change",e=>{const m=e.target.dataset.m;if(!m)return;st.ms[m]=e.target.checked;all(false)});
const upd=document.getElementById("upd");upd.addEventListener("input",()=>{st.u=+upd.value;all(false)});

function head(){
  const k=kOf(51),p51=cur().points.find(p=>p.u===51),sc=st.scope==="all"?"The project is":"Helix is";
  const ex=D.ms["EXS.130"].d,slip=dDiff(ex[51],ex[29]);
  document.getElementById("ttl").textContent=`${sc} ${Math.abs(k.b29.SVt)} working days behind baseline U29, ${Math.abs(k.b32.SVt)} behind U32 and ${Math.abs(k.b38.SVt)} behind U38`;
  document.getElementById("lede").textContent=`At the U51 data date (01-Nov-2026), ${nf(p51.done)} ${unit()} are complete. Baseline U38 expected ${nf(k.b38.P)} by then. Substantial Completion (EXS.130) has moved from ${fd(ex[29])} in U29 to ${fd(ex[51])} in U51, ${slip} working days later.`;
  const s=kOf(st.u),p=cur().points.find(p=>p.u===st.u);
  document.getElementById("kpis").innerHTML=[
   [nf(p.done),`Complete at U${st.u} (${fd(p.dd)})`],
   [Math.round(100*p.done/p.total)+"%",`Progress over ${nf(p.total)} ${unit()} in U${st.u}`],
   ...BL.map(b=>[s["b"+b]?sv(s["b"+b].SVt):"—",s["b"+b]?`SV(t) vs baseline U${b}`:`Baseline U${b} not yet issued`])
  ].map(([v,l])=>`<div class="kpi"><b>${v}</b><span>${l}</span></div>`).join("");
}

const s1=document.getElementById("s1"),tip=document.getElementById("tip");
let geo=null;
function draw(anim){
  const W=s1.clientWidth,H=s1.clientHeight;if(!W)return;
  const C=cur(),small=W<560;
  const L=small?44:62,R=small?10:24,T=14,B=small?30:38,pw=W-L-R,ph=H-T-B;
  const i0=st.win==="u"?D.months.indexOf("2024-09"):0;
  const t0=M[i0].getTime(),t1=M[M.length-1].getTime();
  const X=d=>L+(d.getTime()-t0)/(t1-t0)*pw;
  let mx=0;Object.values(C.curves).forEach(c=>c.forEach(v=>{if(v>mx)mx=v}));
  const log=st.scale==="log";
  let lo=1,hi;
  if(log){const pos=[];BL.forEach(u=>C.curves[u].forEach((v,i)=>i>=i0&&v>0&&pos.push(v)));lo=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(Math.min(...pos))));
    const e=Math.floor(Math.log10(mx*1.05));hi=[1,2,5,10].map(f=>f*10**e).find(v=>v>=mx*1.05)}
  else{const e=Math.floor(Math.log10(mx*1.05));hi=[1,1.2,1.5,2,2.5,3,4,5,6,8,10].map(f=>f*10**e).find(v=>v>=mx*1.05)}
  const Y=v=>log?T+ph-(Math.log10(Math.max(v,lo))-Math.log10(lo))/(Math.log10(hi)-Math.log10(lo))*ph:T+ph-v/hi*ph;
  let g="";
  // paper grid
  if(log){for(let d=lo;d<hi;d*=10)for(let i=1;i<10;i++){const v=d*i;if(v>hi)break;const y=Y(v);
      g+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W-R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(${i===1?"--g1":"--g2"})" stroke-width="${i===1?1.3:.7}"/>`;
}
    for(let d=lo;d<hi;d*=10)for(let i=1;i<10;i++)for(let j=1;j<5;j++){const v=d*(i+j/5);if(v<hi)g+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W-R}" y1="${Y(v)}" y2="${Y(v)}" stroke="var(--g3)" stroke-width=".5"/>`}
    g+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W-R}" y1="${Y(hi)}" y2="${Y(hi)}" stroke="var(--g1)" stroke-width="1.3"/>`;
    for(let d=lo;d<=hi;d*=10){g+=`<text x="${L-6}" y="${Y(d)+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="13" fill="var(--ink)" font-weight="600">${nf(d)}</text>`;
      if(!small)[2,5].forEach(i=>{if(d*i<hi)g+=`<text x="${L-6}" y="${Y(d*i)+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="var(--mute)">${i}</text>`})}
  }else{const st5=hi/10;for(let i=0;i<=50;i++){const v=i*hi/50,y=Y(v),maj=i%5===0;g+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W-R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(${maj?"--g1":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${maj?1:.5}"/>`;
      if(maj)g+=`<text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="var(--ink)">${nf(v)}</text>`}}
  M.forEach((d,i)=>{if(i<i0)return;const x=X(d),yr=d.getMonth()===11;g+=`<line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${T}" y2="${T+ph}" stroke="var(${yr?"--g1":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${yr?1.2:.6}"/>`});
  for(let y=M[i0].getFullYear();y<=M[M.length-1].getFullYear();y++){const a=Math.max(t0,new Date(y,0,1).getTime()),b=Math.min(t1,new Date(y,11,31).getTime());if(b-a<60*864e5)continue;
    g+=`<text x="${L+((a+b)/2-t0)/(t1-t0)*pw}" y="${H-B+20}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="var(--ink)" font-weight="600">${y}</text>`}
  g+=`<rect x="${L}" y="${T}" width="${pw}" height="${ph}" fill="none" stroke="var(--g1)" stroke-width="1.6"/>`;
  const path=(arr,n)=>{let s="",on=false;for(let i=i0;i<(n??arr.length);i++){const v=arr[i];if(log&&v<lo){on=false;continue}s+=(on?"L":"M")+X(M[i]).toFixed(1)+","+Y(v).toFixed(1);on=true}return s};
  // fan
  if(st.fan==="1")Object.keys(C.curves).forEach(u=>{if(+u===st.u)return;g+=`<path d="${path(C.curves[u])}" fill="none" stroke="var(--fan)" stroke-width="1"/>`});
  // data-date of selected update
  const P=C.points.find(p=>p.u===st.u),xd=X(ms(P.dd));
  g+=`<line x1="${xd}" x2="${xd}" y1="${T}" y2="${T+ph}" stroke="var(--sel)" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>`;
  g+=`<text x="${xd+5}" y="${T+44}" font-size="15" fill="var(--sel)" class="hand">data date U${st.u}</text>`;
  const ln=(d,c,w,da,cl)=>`<path ${cl?`class="draw" pathLength="1" style="--L:1"`:""} d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="var(${c})" stroke-width="${w}" ${da?`stroke-dasharray="${da}"`:""} stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
  if(!BL.includes(st.u))g+=ln(path(C.curves[st.u]),"--sel",2.2,"7 4");
  BL.forEach(b=>g+=ln(path(C.curves[b]),"--b"+b,2.2,0,anim));
  // milestones
  let mk=0;MSK.forEach(m=>{if(!st.ms[m])return;const md=D.ms[m].d,c=MSC[m];
    const xf=X(ms(md[st.u]));if(xf>=L&&xf<=W-R){g+=`<line x1="${xf}" x2="${xf}" y1="${T}" y2="${T+ph}" stroke="var(${c})" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="2 4"/>`;
      g+=`<text x="${xf-4}" y="${T+ph-8-mk*18}" text-anchor="end" font-size="${small?12:14}" fill="var(${c})" class="hand">${m} U${st.u}</text>`}
    BL.forEach(b=>{const xb=X(ms(md[b]));if(xb<L||xb>W-R)return;g+=`<path d="M${xb-6},${T+2+mk*12} h12 l-6,10z" fill="var(--b${b})" stroke="var(${c})" stroke-width="1.5"/>`});
    mk++});
  g+=ln(path(C.actual),"--act",3.4,0,anim);
  C.points.forEach(p=>{g+=`<circle cx="${X(ms(p.dd))}" cy="${Y(p.done)}" r="${p.u===st.u?5:3}" fill="var(--paper)" stroke="var(--act)" stroke-width="1.6"/>`});
  // hand labels at right ends
  const lab=(arr,txt,c,dy)=>{const i=arr.length-1;const y=Y(arr[i]);g+=`<text x="${W-R-6}" y="${y+dy}" text-anchor="end" font-size="${small?13:16}" fill="var(${c})" class="hand">${txt}</text>`};
  lab(C.curves[29],"BL U29","--b29",-24);lab(C.curves[32],"BL U32","--b32",-6);lab(C.curves[38],"BL U38","--b38",16);
  const la=C.actual.length-1;g+=`<text x="${X(M[la])-8}" y="${Y(C.actual[la])-10}" text-anchor="end" font-size="${small?14:17}" fill="var(--act)" class="hand">actual ${nf(C.actual[la])}</text>`;
  g+=`<line id="cx" x1="0" x2="0" y1="${T}" y2="${T+ph}" stroke="var(--ink)" stroke-width=".8" opacity="0"/>`;
  s1.innerHTML=g;geo={X,L,pw,t0,t1,W,i0};
}
s1.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{if(!geo)return;const r=s1.getBoundingClientRect(),x=e.clientX-r.left;
  const t=geo.t0+(x-geo.L)/geo.pw*(geo.t1-geo.t0);let i=0,bd=1e18;M.forEach((d,j)=>{if(j<geo.i0)return;const dd=Math.abs(d-t);if(dd<bd){bd=dd;i=j}});
  const C=cur(),cx=document.getElementById("cx");if(x<geo.L||x>geo.L+geo.pw){tip.style.display="none";cx.setAttribute("opacity",0);return}
  cx.setAttribute("x1",geo.X(M[i]));cx.setAttribute("x2",geo.X(M[i]));cx.setAttribute("opacity",.5);
  const row=(c,t,v)=>v==null?"":`<div><span style="color:var(${c})">■</span> ${t}: <b>${nf(v)}</b></div>`;
  tip.innerHTML=`<b>End of ${MES[M[i].getMonth()]}-${M[i].getFullYear()}</b>`+BL.map(b=>row("--b"+b,"BL U"+b,C.curves[b][i])).join("")+row("--act","Actual",C.actual[i])+(!BL.includes(st.u)?row("--sel","U"+st.u,C.curves[st.u][i]):"");
  tip.style.display="block";const tw=tip.offsetWidth;tip.style.left=Math.min(Math.max(x+14,0),r.width-tw-4)+"px";tip.style.top=(e.clientY-r.top>r.height/2?20:r.height-tip.offsetHeight-50)+"px"});
s1.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>{tip.style.display="none"});

const s2=document.getElementById("s2");
function draw2(){
  const W=s2.clientWidth,H=s2.clientHeight;if(!W)return;
  const K=cur().kpi,small=W<560,L=small?40:52,R=12,T=14,B=28,pw=W-L-R,ph=H-T-B;
  const n=K.length,X=i=>L+(i+.5)/n*pw;
  let mn=0,mx=0;K.forEach(k=>BL.map(b=>"b"+b).forEach(b=>{if(k[b]&&k[b].SVt!=null){mn=Math.min(mn,k[b].SVt);mx=Math.max(mx,k[b].SVt)}}));
  // first quadrant: delay (negative SV) is drawn upward, labels keep their sign
  const top=Math.ceil(-mn/100)*100+20,bot=-(Math.ceil(mx/25)*25+15),Y=v=>T+(top+v)/(top-bot)*ph;
  let g="";for(let v=0;v>=-top;v-=50){const y=Y(v);g+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W-R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(${v%100===0?"--g1":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${v===0?1.6:v%100===0?1:.6}"/>`;if(v%100===0)g+=`<text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="var(--ink)">${v}</text>`}
  K.forEach((k,i)=>{const x=X(i);g+=`<line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${T}" y2="${T+ph}" stroke="var(--g3)" stroke-width=".6"/>`;if(!small||i%2===0)g+=`<text x="${x}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="var(${k.u===st.u?"--sel":"--mute"})" font-weight="${k.u===st.u?700:400}">U${k.u}</text>`});
  BL.map(b=>"b"+b).forEach(b=>{const pts=K.map((k,i)=>k[b]&&k[b].SVt!=null?[X(i),Y(k[b].SVt)]:null).filter(Boolean);
    g+=`<polyline points="${pts.map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="none" stroke="var(--${b})" stroke-width="2.2"/>`+pts.map(p=>`<circle cx="${p[0]}" cy="${p[1]}" r="3" fill="var(--paper)" stroke="var(--${b})" stroke-width="1.6"/>`).join("");
    const l=pts[pts.length-1];g+=`<text x="${l[0]-6}" y="${l[1]+({b29:-10,b32:20,b38:20})[b]}" text-anchor="end" font-size="15" class="hand" fill="var(--${b})">vs U${b.slice(1)}</text>`});
  s2.innerHTML=g;
}

function table(){
  const C=cur(),K=C.kpi;
  const h=["Update","Data date","Total","Complete",...BL.flatMap(b=>[`Planned BL U${b}`,`SV(t) U${b}`]),"Forecast finish"];
  const svs=v=>v==null?"—":`<span class="${v<0?"neg":""}">${sv(v)}</span>`;
  document.getElementById("tbl").innerHTML="<thead><tr>"+h.map(x=>`<th>${x}</th>`).join("")+"</tr></thead><tbody>"+K.map(k=>{
    const p=C.points.find(p=>p.u===k.u),up=D.updates.find(x=>x.u===k.u);
    const c=[`U${k.u}`,fd(p.dd),nf(p.total),nf(p.done),...BL.flatMap(b=>[k["b"+b]?nf(k["b"+b].P):"—",svs(k["b"+b]&&k["b"+b].SVt)]),fd(up.finish)];
    return `<tr class="${k.u===st.u?"on":""} ${BL.includes(k.u)?"bl":""}">`+c.map((v,i)=>`<td data-l="${h[i]}">${v}</td>`).join("")+"</tr>"}).join("")+"</tbody>";
  // milestone table
  const mh=["Update",...MSK.flatMap(m=>[m,`Δ vs U29`,`Δ vs U32`,`Δ vs U38`])];
  document.getElementById("mtbl").innerHTML="<thead><tr>"+mh.map(x=>`<th>${x}</th>`).join("")+"</tr></thead><tbody>"+D.updates.map(x=>{const u=x.u;
    const c=[`U${u}`,...MSK.flatMap(m=>{const d=D.ms[m].d;return [fd(d[u]),...BL.map(b=>u<b?"—":svs(-dDiff(d[u],d[b])))]})];
    return `<tr class="${u===st.u?"on":""} ${BL.includes(u)?"bl":""}">`+c.map((v,i)=>`<td data-l="${mh[i]}">${v}</td>`).join("")+"</tr>"}).join("")+"</tbody>";
}

const s3=document.getElementById("s3");
function draw3(){
  const W=s3.clientWidth,H=s3.clientHeight;if(!W)return;
  const small=W<560,L=small?62:78,R=small?12:110,T=16,B=28,pw=W-L-R,ph=H-T-B,UU=D.updates.map(x=>x.u),n=UU.length,X=i=>L+(i+.5)/n*pw;
  const on=MSK.filter(m=>st.ms[m]);const all=(on.length?on:MSK).flatMap(m=>UU.map(u=>ms(D.ms[m].d[u]).getTime()));
  const a=new Date(Math.min(...all)),b=new Date(Math.max(...all));const y0=new Date(a.getFullYear(),a.getMonth()-1,1),y1=new Date(b.getFullYear(),b.getMonth()+2,1);
  const Y=d=>T+ph-(d-y0)/(y1-y0)*ph;let g="";
  for(let d=new Date(y0);d<=y1;d.setMonth(d.getMonth()+1)){const y=Y(d),q=d.getMonth()%3===0;g+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${L+pw}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(${d.getMonth()===0?"--g1":q?"--g2":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${d.getMonth()===0?1.2:.6}"/>`;
    if(q&&(!small||d.getMonth()%6===0))g+=`<text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="var(${d.getMonth()===0?"--ink":"--mute"})" font-weight="${d.getMonth()===0?600:400}">${MES[d.getMonth()]}-${String(d.getFullYear()).slice(2)}</text>`}
  UU.forEach((u,i)=>{const x=X(i);g+=`<line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${T}" y2="${T+ph}" stroke="var(${BL.includes(u)?"--g2":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${BL.includes(u)?1:.5}"/>`;if(!small||i%2===0)g+=`<text x="${x}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="var(${u===st.u?"--sel":BL.includes(u)?"--b"+u:"--mute"})" font-weight="${u===st.u||BL.includes(u)?700:400}">U${u}</text>`});
  // diagonal = data date line (classic MTA)
  const dpts=UU.map((u,i)=>[X(i),Y(ms(D.updates[i].dd))]).filter(p=>p[1]>=T&&p[1]<=T+ph);
  if(dpts.length>1)g+=`<polyline points="${dpts.map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="none" stroke="var(--mute)" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>`;
  on.forEach(m=>{const c=MSC[m],pts=UU.map((u,i)=>[X(i),Y(ms(D.ms[m].d[u]))]);
    g+=`<polyline points="${pts.map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="none" stroke="var(${c})" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`+pts.map((p,i)=>`<circle cx="${p[0]}" cy="${p[1]}" r="${UU[i]===st.u?5:3}" fill="${BL.includes(UU[i])?`var(--b${UU[i]})`:"var(--paper)"}" stroke="var(${c})" stroke-width="1.6"/>`).join("");
    const l=pts[pts.length-1];if(!small)g+=`<text x="${l[0]+10}" y="${l[1]+5}" font-size="15" class="hand" fill="var(${c})">${m}</text>`});
  if(!on.length)g+=`<text x="${L+pw/2}" y="${T+ph/2}" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--mute)">Turn on a milestone above to plot its trend.</text>`;
  s3.innerHTML=g;
}

function notes(){
  const u=D.updates;
  document.getElementById("notes").innerHTML=[
   `<b>Source.</b> One XER per update, U29 (data date 01-Jan-2025) to U51 (data date 01-Nov-2026), from the SCHEDULER folder. For U41, NIH.SRLM.U41 was used (${nf(u.find(x=>x.u===41).n)} tasks, consistent with U40 and U42); file PH1.U41-R0 carries 581 extra tasks and was left out. The two U49 XER files match in task count and status.`,
   `<b>Population.</b> Task-type activities only. Milestones, LOE and WBS summary activities are excluded. Helix = activities coded Resp | SRLM “Helix | Electrical” or “Helix | Fire Alarm”.`,
   `<b>Baselines.</b> U29 (01-Jan-2025), U32 (01-Apr-2025) and U38 (01-Oct-2025), each as the full schedule stood at its data date, including work already completed.`,
   `<b>Curve of each schedule.</b> Each activity is placed at its finish date: actual if complete, early if not. The curve is the cumulative count of finishes at each month end.`,
   `<b>Scenarios.</b> “Upstream of” keeps only the activities that drive the chosen milestone through the logic network (all predecessors, any depth) in each schedule's own logic. EXS.130 Substantial Completion – Phase 0,1,2; P2.PIA.120 Final Life Safety Testing & Inspection; P2.PIA.130 Final Acceptance Inspections & Certification. Upstream of EXS.130 sits ${nf(D.ms["EXS.130"].n[51])} tasks in U51, so its S-curve barely differs from the full schedule. P2.PIA.120 dropped from ${nf(D.ms["P2.PIA.120"].n[46])} to ${nf(D.ms["P2.PIA.120"].n[47])} upstream tasks at U47: its logic was re-tied in that update.`,
   `<b>Actual progress.</b> The black line uses the actual finish dates in U51. The circles are what each update reported as complete at its data date; any gap between the two is work deleted, added or re-statused afterwards.`,
   `<b>Working days.</b> Every day count on this page (SV(t), milestone Δ) is in working days on calendar 5D w/ Holidays | SRLM (clndr 3000, Monday–Friday, ${D.hol.length} weekday holidays), the calendar of 98% of the activities in U51. EXS.130 itself sits on the 7-day calendar, but its shift is reported on the same 5-day calendar so all figures are comparable.`,
   `<b>Activity-days.</b> The alternate measure weights each activity by its original duration (target_drtn / 8 h). These schedules carry no costs, so this is not earned value.`,
   `<b>SV(t).</b> Earned schedule on counts: find the date on which the baseline was due to reach the completed amount (counting only baseline activities complete in the update, matched by Activity ID) and count the working days from there to the data date. Since U29, ${D.del29} activities were deleted and ${nf(D.add29)} added; since U32, ${D.del32} and ${D.add32}; since U38, ${D.del38} and ${D.add38}.`,
   `<b>Milestone trend.</b> Forecast (early) finish of each milestone in every update; Δ is the working-day difference against the same milestone in each baseline; negative means later than the baseline, the same sign convention as SV(t). The dashed diagonal is the data date: a milestone line that approaches it without flattening keeps slipping.`,
   `<b>Hidden delay.</b> Progress delay is SV(t) for the activities upstream of EXS.130; milestone slip is the working-day shift of EXS.130 against the same baseline. Required pace = incomplete upstream activities ÷ working days from data date to the EXS.130 forecast, × 21. Demonstrated pace = activities completed per month over the previous three updates (whole project). Duration edits were tested and rejected as the cause: between consecutive updates, the original durations of activities not started in either update changed by between −293 and +127 days in total across thousands of activities, with no consistent shortening.`,
   `<b>Driving path.</b> Each update was recomputed with an independent forward pass (retained logic, lag on predecessor calendar, level-of-effort activities as non-driving hammocks). It reproduces P6's EXS.130 date exactly in 11 of 14 updates and within 5 days in the rest, and matches P6's early finish for 96–98% of open activities. The path is traced back from EXS.130 through the binding relationship at each step. P6's own Longest Path flag (driving_path_flag) is a single chain in U50 and U51 and matches this trace; in earlier updates it marks 96–255 open activities and cannot separate chains. An earlier version of this page traced through a level-of-effort summary (P2.SUM.265) and wrongly showed Helix fire alarm driving in U45 and U47. Change work = activities under WBS nodes named PCO or Fragnet; FRG mechanical fragnets sit outside those nodes.`,
   `<b>Feasibility and capacity forecast.</b> Required pace = mean monthly finishes in each baseline's first twelve months after its data date. Capacity forecast = open activities upstream of EXS.130 at U51 ÷ demonstrated monthly pace, converted to working days on the SRLM calendar from 02-Nov-2026. It ignores logic, so it is a floor for what capacity allows, not a schedule. An earned-schedule extrapolation (IEAC(t) with SPI(t) 0.30–0.42) gives 2029–2031; it is not shown because applying a constant SPI(t) to the front-loaded U38 curve overstates the remaining duration.`,
   `<b>Collapsed but-for and contract reference.</b> U51 (and U50) recalculated with the validated forward pass after deleting the open activities of the change and their relationships. It measures the time the change adds as modelled; it does not establish entitlement, responsibility or concurrency. The contract reference is the EXS.140 CS_MEOB constraint and the project must-finish date (plan_end_date) stored in each XER; no contract documents were available. The activity 'Finish date 1465 Cal Days from NTP per contract' refers to the Phase 5 proposal (NTP 26-Apr-2022 + 1,465 days = 30-Apr-2026), not to completion.`,
   `<b>Log paper.</b> On a semi-log scale, slope is growth rate, not quantity: two parallel curves progress at the same relative pace even when offset. The flattening of the actual curve against the baselines is a loss of pace, not just accumulated delay.`
  ].map(x=>`<p>${x}</p>`).join("");
}


const HS={ref:"38"};
document.getElementById("sHid").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("button");if(!b)return;HS.ref=b.dataset.v;draw4()});
const s4=document.getElementById("s4"),s5=document.getElementById("s5");
function draw4(){
  document.querySelectorAll("#sHid button").forEach(b=>b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",b.dataset.v===HS.ref));
  const Hd=D.hid.filter(h=>h["sv"+HS.ref]!=null),r=HS.ref;
  const g47=Hd.find(h=>h.u===47),g51=Hd.find(h=>h.u===51);
  document.getElementById("hidL").textContent=`Against baseline U${r}, progress upstream of EXS.130 was ${-g47["sv"+r]} working days behind at U47 while the milestone had moved only ${-g47["sl"+r]}. The gap closed in two jumps, U48 and U50; at U51 the milestone shows ${-g51["sl"+r]} working days against ${-g51["sv"+r]} of progress delay. EXS.130 never had positive float: it was already ${-D.hid[0].tf} days negative in U29, and the late finish was moved twice, to 07-Jan-2027 in U35 and to the forecast date, 21-Apr-2027, in U38, which reset float to zero.`;
  const W=s4.clientWidth,H=s4.clientHeight;if(!W)return;
  const small=W<560,L=small?40:52,R=12,T=16,B=28,pw=W-L-R,ph=H-T-B,n=D.hid.length,X=i=>L+(i+.5)/n*pw,ix=u=>D.hid.findIndex(h=>h.u===u);
  let mn=0,mx=0;Hd.forEach(h=>{mn=Math.min(mn,h["sv"+r],h["sl"+r]);mx=Math.max(mx,h["sv"+r],h["sl"+r])});
  const top=Math.ceil(-mn/50)*50+20,bot=-(Math.ceil(mx/25)*25+10),Y=v=>T+(top+v)/(top-bot)*ph;
  let g="";for(let v=0;v>=-top;v-=25){const y=Y(v),maj=v%100===0;g+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W-R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(${maj?"--g1":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${v===0?1.6:maj?1:.6}"/>`;if(v%50===0)g+=`<text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="var(--ink)">${v}</text>`}
  D.hid.forEach((h,i)=>{const x=X(i);g+=`<line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${T}" y2="${T+ph}" stroke="var(--g3)" stroke-width=".5"/>`;if(!small||i%2===0)g+=`<text x="${x}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="var(--mute)">U${h.u}</text>`});
  // gap area where progress delay exceeds slip
  const P1=Hd.map(h=>[X(ix(h.u)),Y(h["sv"+r])]),P2=Hd.map(h=>[X(ix(h.u)),Y(Math.max(h["sl"+r],h["sv"+r]))]);
  g+=`<polygon points="${P1.map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ")} ${P2.reverse().map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="var(--sel)" opacity=".28"/>`;
  [[35,"deadline → 07-Jan-27"],[38,"deadline → 21-Apr-27"]].forEach(([u,txt])=>{if(+r>u)return;const x=X(ix(u));g+=`<line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${T}" y2="${T+ph}" stroke="var(--b38)" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/>`;if(!small)g+=`<text x="${x+4}" y="${T+14}" font-size="14" class="hand" fill="var(--b38)">${txt}</text>`});
  const line=(k,c,w)=>{const p=Hd.map(h=>[X(ix(h.u)),Y(h[k])]);return `<polyline points="${p.map(q=>q.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="none" stroke="var(${c})" stroke-width="${w}" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`+p.map(q=>`<circle cx="${q[0]}" cy="${q[1]}" r="3" fill="var(--paper)" stroke="var(${c})" stroke-width="1.6"/>`).join("")};
  g+=line("sv"+r,"--act",3)+line("sl"+r,"--m0",2.4);
  const i47=ix(47);g+=`<text x="${X(i47)}" y="${(Y(g47["sv"+r])+Y(g47["sl"+r]))/2+5}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="${small?13:16}" class="hand" fill="var(--sel)">${g47["sl"+r]-g47["sv"+r]} wd</text>`;
  s4.innerHTML=g;
  // pace chart
  const W5=s5.clientWidth,H5=s5.clientHeight;if(!W5)return;
  const pw5=W5-L-R,ph5=H5-T-B,X5=i=>L+(i+.5)/n*pw5;const hi=400,Y5=v=>T+ph5-v/hi*ph5;
  let k="";for(let v=0;v<=hi;v+=50){const y=Y5(v);k+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W5-R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(${v%100===0?"--g1":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${v%100===0?1:.6}"/>`;if(v%100===0)k+=`<text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="var(--ink)">${v}</text>`}
  D.hid.forEach((h,i)=>{if(!small||i%2===0)k+=`<text x="${X5(i)}" y="${H5-8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="var(--mute)">U${h.u}</text>`});
  const H2=D.hid.filter(h=>h.demo!=null);
  const A=H2.map(h=>[X5(ix(h.u)),Y5(h.req)]),Bp=H2.map(h=>[X5(ix(h.u)),Y5(Math.min(h.req,h.demo))]);
  k+=`<polygon points="${A.map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ")} ${Bp.reverse().map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="var(--sel)" opacity=".28"/>`;
  const l5=(arr,key,c,w)=>{const p=arr.map(h=>[X5(ix(h.u)),Y5(h[key])]);return `<polyline points="${p.map(q=>q.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="none" stroke="var(${c})" stroke-width="${w}"/>`+p.map(q=>`<circle cx="${q[0]}" cy="${q[1]}" r="3" fill="var(--paper)" stroke="var(${c})" stroke-width="1.5"/>`).join("")};
  k+=l5(D.hid,"req","--m0",2.4)+l5(H2,"demo","--act",2.6);
  s5.innerHTML=k;
}

const s6=document.getElementById("s6");
function draw6(){
  const R6=D.drive,W=s6.clientWidth,H=s6.clientHeight;if(!W)return;
  const small=W<560,L=small?58:74,R=small?12:24,T=18,B=28,pw=W-L-R,ph=H-T-B,n=R6.length,X=i=>L+(i+.5)/n*pw;
  const ds=R6.flatMap(r=>[ms(r.exs),ms(r.hl.fin)]);const a=new Date(Math.min(...ds)),b=new Date(Math.max(...ds));
  const y0=new Date(a.getFullYear(),a.getMonth()-1,1),y1=new Date(b.getFullYear(),b.getMonth()+2,1),Y=d=>T+ph-(d-y0)/(y1-y0)*ph;
  let g="";for(let d=new Date(y0);d<=y1;d.setMonth(d.getMonth()+1)){const y=Y(d),q=d.getMonth()%3===0;g+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${L+pw}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(${d.getMonth()===0?"--g1":q?"--g2":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${d.getMonth()===0?1.2:.6}"/>`;
    if(q&&(!small||d.getMonth()%6===0))g+=`<text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="var(${d.getMonth()===0?"--ink":"--mute"})" font-weight="${d.getMonth()===0?600:400}">${MES[d.getMonth()]}-${String(d.getFullYear()).slice(2)}</text>`}
  R6.forEach((r,i)=>{const x=X(i);g+=`<line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${T}" y2="${T+ph}" stroke="var(--g3)" stroke-width=".5"/>`;if(!small||i%2===0)g+=`<text x="${x}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="var(--mute)">U${r.u}</text>`});
  const E=R6.map((r,i)=>[X(i),Y(ms(r.exs))]),Hh=R6.map((r,i)=>[X(i),Y(ms(r.hl.fin))]);
  g+=`<polygon points="${E.map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ")} ${[...Hh].reverse().map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="var(--sel)" opacity=".18"/>`;
  g+=`<polyline points="${Hh.map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="none" stroke="var(--act)" stroke-width="2.6"/>`+Hh.map(p=>`<circle cx="${p[0]}" cy="${p[1]}" r="3" fill="var(--paper)" stroke="var(--act)" stroke-width="1.6"/>`).join("");
  g+=`<polyline points="${E.map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="none" stroke="var(--m0)" stroke-width="2.6"/>`;
  const cc={mech:"--cm",hel:"--ch",chg:"--cc"};R6.forEach((r,i)=>g+=`<circle cx="${E[i][0]}" cy="${E[i][1]}" r="${small?5:7}" fill="var(${cc[r.cat]})" stroke="var(--paper)" stroke-width="1.5"/>`);
  [47,51].forEach(u=>{const i=R6.findIndex(r=>r.u===u);if(i<0)return;const r=R6[i];g+=`<text x="${X(i)-10}" y="${(E[i][1]+Hh[i][1])/2+5}" text-anchor="end" font-size="${small?13:16}" class="hand" fill="var(--sel)">${r.gap} wd</text>`});
  if(!small){const i=R6.length-1;g+=`<text x="${X(i)-12}" y="${E[i][1]-10}" text-anchor="end" font-size="15" class="hand" fill="var(--m0)">EXS.130</text><text x="${X(i)-12}" y="${Hh[i][1]+26}" text-anchor="end" font-size="15" class="hand" fill="var(--act)">${R6[i].hl.code}</text>`}
  s6.innerHTML=g;
  const cn={mech:"Mechanical commissioning",hel:"Helix energization (after Fragnet 001)",chg:"PCO / RFP change"};
  const h=["Update","EXS.130","Driven by","Chain starts at → enters testing via","Helix on path","Change on path","Helix last activity","Helix finish","Gap to EXS.130"];
  document.getElementById("dtbl").innerHTML="<thead><tr>"+h.map(x=>`<th>${x}</th>`).join("")+"</tr></thead><tbody>"+R6.map(r=>{
    const c=[`U${r.u}`,fd(r.exs),`<span class="dot" style="background:var(${cc[r.cat]})"></span>${cn[r.cat]}`,`${r.origin.code} ${r.origin.name.replace(/\s+\|\s+/g," | ").slice(0,60)} → ${r.via.code}`,r.hel,r.chg,r.hl.code,fd(r.hl.fin),r.gap+" wd"];
    return `<tr class="${r.u===st.u?"on":""}">`+c.map((v,i)=>`<td data-l="${h[i]}" style="${i===3?"white-space:normal;text-align:left;min-width:220px":i===2?"text-align:left":""}">${v}</td>`).join("")+"</tr>"}).join("")+"</tbody>";
}

const s7=document.getElementById("s7"),s8=document.getElementById("s8");
function draw7(){
  const C=D.integ.churn,W=s7.clientWidth,H=s7.clientHeight;if(!W)return;
  const small=W<560,L=small?44:56,R=12,T=14,B=28,pw=W-L-R,ph=H-T-B,n=C.length,bw=pw/n,X=i=>L+i*bw;
  const hi=1500,Y=v=>T+ph-v/hi*ph;let g="";
  for(let v=0;v<=hi;v+=250){const y=Y(v);g+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W-R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(${v%500===0?"--g1":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${v%500===0?1:.6}"/>`;if(v%500===0)g+=`<text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="var(--ink)">${nf(v)}</text>`}
  C.forEach((c,i)=>{const w=Math.max(3,bw*.32),x=X(i)+bw/2;g+=`<rect x="${x-w-1}" y="${Y(c.rem)}" width="${w}" height="${T+ph-Y(c.rem)}" fill="var(--b38)"/><rect x="${x+1}" y="${Y(c.add)}" width="${w}" height="${T+ph-Y(c.add)}" fill="var(--b29)"/>`;
    if(!small||i%2===0)g+=`<text x="${x}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="var(${[44,47].includes(c.u)?"--ink":"--mute"})" font-weight="${[44,47].includes(c.u)?700:400}">U${c.u}</text>`;
    if(c.u===47&&!small)g+=`<text x="${x+w+6}" y="${Y(c.rem)+12}" font-size="15" class="hand" fill="var(--b38)">logic rework</text>`});
  s7.innerHTML=g;
  const G=D.integ.gaps,W8=s8.clientWidth,H8=s8.clientHeight;if(!W8)return;
  const pw8=W8-L-R,ph8=H8-T-B,n8=G.length,X8=i=>L+(i+.5)/n8*pw8,hi8=300,Y8=v=>T+ph8-v/hi8*ph8;let k="";
  for(let v=0;v<=hi8;v+=50){const y=Y8(v);k+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W8-R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(${v%100===0?"--g1":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${v%100===0?1:.6}"/>`;if(v%100===0)k+=`<text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="var(--ink)">${v}</text>`}
  G.forEach((x,i)=>{if(!small||i%4===0)k+=`<text x="${X8(i)}" y="${H8-8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="var(--mute)">U${x.u}</text>`});
  const ln=(key,c)=>{const p=G.filter(x=>x[key]!=null).map(x=>[X8(G.indexOf(x)),Y8(x[key])]);return `<polyline points="${p.map(q=>q.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="none" stroke="var(${c})" stroke-width="2.4"/>`+p.map(q=>`<circle cx="${q[0]}" cy="${q[1]}" r="2.6" fill="var(--paper)" stroke="var(${c})" stroke-width="1.5"/>`).join("")};
  k+=ln("oos","--act")+ln("retro","--sel");
  s8.innerHTML=k;
}

const s9=document.getElementById("s9"),s10=document.getElementById("s10");
function draw9(){
  const F=D.feas,S=F.series,dm=F.demo,rq=F.req;
  document.getElementById("feasL").textContent=`No baseline was planned at the pace the project has shown. U29 and U32 asked for ${rq["29"].avg} and ${rq["32"].avg} finishes per month over their first year, more than the best month on record (${nf(dm.best)}, ${MES[+dm.best_m.slice(5)-1]}-${dm.best_m.slice(0,4)}) sustained for twelve months. U38 lowered the average to ${rq["38"].avg}, below that best month, but still 1.2 times the 2025 average (${dm.y2025}) and 1.6 times the last twelve months (${dm.l12}), with a ${nf(rq["38"].peak)} peak in its second month. That is why SPI(t) stays between 0.3 and 0.4.`;
  const W=s9.clientWidth,H=s9.clientHeight;if(!W)return;
  const small=W<560,L=small?40:52,R=12,T=14,B=28,pw=W-L-R,ph=H-T-B,n=S.months.length,bw=pw/n,X=i=>L+(i+.5)*bw,hi=800,Y=v=>T+ph-Math.min(v,hi)/hi*ph;
  let g="";for(let v=0;v<=hi;v+=100){const y=Y(v);g+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W-R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(${v%200===0?"--g1":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${v%200===0?1:.6}"/>`;if(v%200===0)g+=`<text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="var(--ink)">${v}</text>`}
  S.months.forEach((m,i)=>{if(m.endsWith("-01")){const x=L+i*bw;g+=`<line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${T}" y2="${T+ph}" stroke="var(--g1)" stroke-width="1"/><text x="${x+4}" y="${H-8}" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="var(--ink)">${m.slice(0,4)}</text>`}});
  S.actual.forEach((v,i)=>{if(v==null)return;g+=`<rect x="${L+i*bw+bw*.15}" y="${Y(v)}" width="${bw*.7}" height="${T+ph-Y(v)}" fill="var(--cm)" opacity=".75"/>`});
  const ln=(arr,c,w,da)=>{let s="",on=false;arr.forEach((v,i)=>{if(v==null){on=false;return}s+=(on?"L":"M")+X(i).toFixed(1)+","+Y(v).toFixed(1);on=true});return `<path d="${s}" fill="none" stroke="var(${c})" stroke-width="${w}" ${da?`stroke-dasharray="${da}"`:""} stroke-linejoin="round"/>`};
  const cut=(b,start)=>S.bl[b].map((v,i)=>S.months[i]>start?v:null);
  g+=ln(cut("29","2025-01"),"--b29",2.2)+ln(cut("32","2025-04"),"--b32",2.2)+ln(cut("38","2025-10"),"--b38",2.2)+ln(cut("51","2026-11"),"--sel",2.2,"6 4");
  g+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${W-R}" y1="${Y(dm.best)}" y2="${Y(dm.best)}" stroke="var(--act)" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-dasharray="2 4"/>`;
  if(!small)g+=`<text x="${W-R-6}" y="${Y(dm.best)-6}" text-anchor="end" font-size="15" class="hand" fill="var(--act)">best month ever, ${nf(dm.best)}</text>`;
  s9.innerHTML=g;
  const h=["Baseline","Required, first 12 months (avg / month)","Peak month","× best month ever","× last 12 months"];
  document.getElementById("ftbl").innerHTML="<thead><tr>"+h.map(x=>`<th>${x}</th>`).join("")+"</tr></thead><tbody>"+["29","32","38"].map(b=>{const r=rq[b];
    const c=[`U${b}`,nf(r.avg),`${nf(r.peak)} (${MES[+r.peak_m.slice(5)-1]}-${r.peak_m.slice(2,4)})`,(r.avg/dm.best).toFixed(2),(r.avg/dm.l12).toFixed(2)];
    return "<tr>"+c.map((v,i)=>`<td data-l="${h[i]}">${v}</td>`).join("")+"</tr>"}).join("")+"</tbody>";
  // forecasts
  const fc=F.fc;
  document.getElementById("fcL").textContent=`${nf(F.rem)} activities upstream of EXS.130 are still open at U51. At the pace of the last six months they finish around ${fd(fc[0].date)}, at the last twelve months' pace around ${fd(fc[1].date)}. The U51 CPM date, ${fd("2028-03-27")}, needs only 176 per month: today the date is set by the PCO 1643 logic, not by capacity, as long as the pace does not fall below that.`;
  const rows=[{n:"Baseline U29",d:D.ms["EXS.130"].d[29],c:"--b29"},{n:"Baseline U38",d:D.ms["EXS.130"].d[38],c:"--b38"},{n:`Capacity at ${fc[2].rate}/mo (2025 avg)`,d:fc[2].date,c:"--cm"},{n:`Capacity at ${fc[1].rate}/mo (last 12 mo)`,d:fc[1].date,c:"--act"},{n:`Capacity at ${fc[0].rate}/mo (last 6 mo)`,d:fc[0].date,c:"--act"},{n:"U51 CPM (PCO 1643 logic)",d:"2028-03-27",c:"--sel"}];
  const W2=s10.clientWidth,H2=s10.clientHeight;if(!W2)return;
  const sm=W2<600,L2=sm?12:230,R2=20,T2=24,B2=26,pw2=W2-L2-R2,rh=(H2-T2-B2)/rows.length;
  const a0=new Date(2026,9,1),a1=new Date(2028,5,30),X2=d=>L2+(d-a0)/(a1-a0)*pw2;
  let k="";for(let d=new Date(a0);d<=a1;d.setMonth(d.getMonth()+1)){const x=X2(d),q=d.getMonth()%3===0;k+=`<line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${T2-6}" y2="${H2-B2}" stroke="var(${d.getMonth()===0?"--g1":q?"--g2":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${d.getMonth()===0?1.2:.6}"/>`;
    if(q&&(!sm||d.getMonth()%6===0))k+=`<text x="${x}" y="${H2-8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="var(${d.getMonth()===0?"--ink":"--mute"})">${MES[d.getMonth()]}-${String(d.getFullYear()).slice(2)}</text>`}
  const xd=X2(ms("2026-11-01"));k+=`<line x1="${xd}" x2="${xd}" y1="${T2-10}" y2="${H2-B2}" stroke="var(--sel)" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/><text x="${xd+4}" y="${T2-10}" font-size="13" class="hand" fill="var(--sel)">data date U51</text>`;
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{const y=T2+rh*(i+.5),x=X2(ms(r.d));
    k+=`<line x1="${Math.min(xd,x)}" x2="${x}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(${r.c})" stroke-width="2" opacity=".5"/>`;
    k+=`<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="6" fill="var(${r.c})" stroke="var(--paper)" stroke-width="1.5"/>`;
    if(sm)k+=`<text x="${L2+2}" y="${y-9}" font-size="12" fill="var(--ink)">${r.n} · ${fd(r.d)}</text>`;
    else k+=`<text x="${L2-10}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="13" fill="var(--ink)">${r.n}</text><text x="${x+10}" y="${y+4}" font-size="13" fill="var(--mute)">${fd(r.d)}</text>`});
  s10.innerHTML=k;
}

const s11=document.getElementById("s11");
function draw11(){
  const C=D.contract;
  document.getElementById("ctL").textContent=`The XER files carry no contractual date for Substantial Completion (EXS.130 has no constraint). The only completion date of that kind is the "finish on or before" constraint on EXS.140 Phase 5 Complete, which is also the project must-finish date and the source of EXS.130's late dates. It was 16-Sep-2028 until U34. In U35 it became 13-Oct-2028, the finish U29 had forecast; in U38 it became 25-Jan-2029, the finish U38 forecast that same month. U51 forecasts 01-Jan-2030: 326 working days past the original date and 237 past the current one. Without PCO 1643 the project would still finish 16-Jun-2029, 101 working days past the current date.`;
  const W=s11.clientWidth,H=s11.clientHeight;if(!W)return;
  const small=W<560,L=small?58:74,R=12,T=16,B=28,pw=W-L-R,ph=H-T-B,n=C.length,X=i=>L+(i+.5)/n*pw;
  const ds=C.flatMap(r=>[ms(r.ef140),ms(r.c140[1])]).concat([ms("2029-06-16")]);const a=new Date(Math.min(...ds)),b=new Date(Math.max(...ds));
  const y0=new Date(a.getFullYear(),a.getMonth()-1,1),y1=new Date(b.getFullYear(),b.getMonth()+2,1),Y=d=>T+ph-(d-y0)/(y1-y0)*ph;
  let g="";for(let d=new Date(y0);d<=y1;d.setMonth(d.getMonth()+1)){const y=Y(d),q=d.getMonth()%3===0;g+=`<line x1="${L}" x2="${L+pw}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="var(${d.getMonth()===0?"--g1":q?"--g2":"--g3"})" stroke-width="${d.getMonth()===0?1.2:.6}"/>`;
    if(q&&(!small||d.getMonth()%6===0))g+=`<text x="${L-6}" y="${y+4}" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="var(${d.getMonth()===0?"--ink":"--mute"})">${MES[d.getMonth()]}-${String(d.getFullYear()).slice(2)}</text>`}
  C.forEach((r,i)=>{if(!small||i%4===0)g+=`<text x="${X(i)}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="var(--mute)">U${r.u}</text>`});
  let st="";C.forEach((r,i)=>{const y=Y(ms(r.c140[1])),x0=L+i/n*pw,x1=L+(i+1)/n*pw;st+=(i?"L":"M")+x0+","+y+"L"+x1+","+y});
  g+=`<path d="${st}" fill="none" stroke="var(--b38)" stroke-width="2.6"/>`;
  const F=C.map((r,i)=>[X(i),Y(ms(r.ef140))]);
  g+=`<polyline points="${F.map(p=>p.join(",")).join(" ")}" fill="none" stroke="var(--act)" stroke-width="2.4"/>`+F.map(p=>`<circle cx="${p[0]}" cy="${p[1]}" r="3" fill="var(--paper)" stroke="var(--act)" stroke-width="1.6"/>`).join("");
  const li=C.length-1,xn=X(li),yn=Y(ms("2029-06-16"));g+=`<line x1="${F[li][0]}" y1="${F[li][1]}" x2="${xn}" y2="${yn}" stroke="var(--sel)" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/><circle cx="${xn}" cy="${yn}" r="5" fill="var(--sel)"/>`;
  if(!small){
    [[35,"= U29 forecast"],[38,"= U38 forecast"]].forEach(([u,txt])=>{const i=C.findIndex(r=>r.u===u);g+=`<text x="${X(i)+4}" y="${Y(ms(C[i].c140[1]))+20}" text-anchor="start" font-size="14" class="hand" fill="var(--b38)">${txt}</text>`})}
  s11.innerHTML=g;
}
function all(anim=true){syncSeg();document.getElementById("updL").textContent="U"+st.u;head();draw(anim);draw2();draw3();draw4();draw6();draw7();draw9();draw11();table()}
new ResizeObserver(()=>{draw(false);draw2();draw3();draw4();draw6();draw7();draw9();draw11()}).observe(document.getElementById("f1"));
notes();all(true);
}
</script>
